authority: User explicitly requested every US/UK listed company, numerical filtering, AI research on the top 100, and implementation on 10 November 2026.
universe: Current Nasdaq/other US exchange directories, LSE equity instrument list including AIM, and Aquis security list. Retain excluded and unmapped securities; exclude OTC/private companies and duplicate or unresolved share classes from ranking.
enterprise_value_proxy: market_cap+vendor_total_debt-vendor_cash_and_short_term_investments; preferred capital/noncontrolling claims not included, not assumed zero. This is a discovery proxy, not the registered EV definition.
liquidity: Median vendor daily close * volume over 60 completed observations converted to GBP. Bulk historical adjustment conventions are unverified; this is an exploratory liquidity proxy, not verified execution capacity.
score: 100 * (0.5 * mean(three quality percentiles) + 0.5 * mean(two value percentiles)); average tied ranks within country/sector, (average_rank-1)/(n-1)
top100: Up to 100 highest-scored unique issuers in the top quintile of this score within their country/sector peer group. Tie break stable listing ID; fewer than 100 is valid. Freeze only after the complete source scan.
missing_policy: No zero-filling. Missing inputs, invalid units, nonpositive EV, stale facts, small peer groups and unresolved identities remain unranked with reasons.
ai: Frozen shortlist, sequential durable dossier and rating queue, primary-source reconciliation recorded as supported/contradicted/insufficient evidence. AI cannot rewrite original screen inputs. Never label AI checks independently verified.
baseline: Standard 1.0.0 and all six registered strategies unchanged. No broker eligibility, historical alpha, calibrated probability, sector-neutral portfolio or corporate-action-corrected backtest claim.
